# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Platform backports**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports the Apple TFM fix and WinUI .NET 9 projection fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 fixed** — The WinUI native projection DLL was missing from the package for .NET 9 consumers, causing a load failure at startup. The asset is now correctly included. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library packages now use versioned TFMs (e.g. ios26.0) and app packages use unversioned ones (e.g. ios), aligning with .NET Apple TFM conventions for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
